items.label: OUTDOOR FUN
items.value: Sail the high seas from any outdoor playground or jungle gym! Complete or update your current backyard swing set with a telescope from Squirrel Products.

items.label: DEPENDABLE
items.value: The Telescopes durable plastic construction will allow it to stand up to weather and children who play non stop! Designed with kids in mind, it can move up & down and rotates 360 degrees.

items.label: OUTSIDE ACTIVITIES MADE SIMPLE
items.value: The non- magnifying telescope measures approx. 14" long and includes all required mounting hardware. Easy do it yourself installation for quick backyard fun.

items.label: MADE WITH YOUR CHILD IN MIND
items.value: Our toys and sporting goods are modernized versions of popular, best selling classics, with improved safety and play functionality.

items.label: Additional Features
items.value: Pirate-themed outdoor play telescope with improved safety and functionality
